title: Vasconcellos Seeks New Ways to Provide Medical Marijuana to Patients as Lungren and Clinton Try to Stop It.

content_html_sanitized:
SACRAMENTO, Jan. 12
State Sen. John Vasconcellos, (D.Santa Clara) long a sponsor of medical marijuana legislation in California announced a new effort to find ways for the legal distribution of marijuana for medical use by preparing a Public Safety Committee summit on the issue and legislation to more effectively implement Prop. 215 and set up distribution of cannabis to patients suffering from AIDS, cancer and other diseases.
This will force the hand of Attorney General Dan Lungren who is running for Governor on his fearless record of persecuting the sick and dying. The Clinton Administration has filed a federal civil suit to shut down the buyers clubs. This law suit will have no effect on the Vasconcellos approach even though it would also violate the federal laws. (Contact: Rand Martin, Vasconellos spokesman 916-445-9740)
